description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's @{upstream} and related refspec syntax. It sets up a repository environment, executes various tests to verify the correctness of reference resolution, upstream tracking behavior, and related Git commands. The script leverages functions like test_expect_success and test_must_fail to define individual test cases.

methods.name: commit_subject
methods.description: Extracts the subject line of a commit from the cloned repository.

methods.name: error_message
methods.description: Runs a Git command expecting it to fail and captures its error output.
